issues.on_page: Local 355,156 (General Fund budget schedule); Exhibit D General column (p4): Charges for Services 326,446, Interest 8,006, Miscellaneous 15,914, rest intergovernmental 4,790
issues.issue: The General Fund 'Local' line is in 'other', but the report's own Exhibit D breakdown shows about 92% of it is Charges for Services. The extractor rules say a broad 'Local' line takes any category that makes up more than half of it, so this should be charges for services/fees (with review naming the mix), unless the context check rules otherwise. The amount is correct.
issues.resolved: 'Local' is a context label: stays other until the context check (CLAUDE.md 2026-11-05 rule)
